statement: GET / answers 301 to /m/, the same status and target the source answers.

Every in-scope route serves its hydrated DOM rather than the source's 58,003-byte S3 shell, and the source app bundle is removed so the client router cannot re-take the page and 404 itself on local paths.

A route shape inside the clone's scope but outside its captured frontier answers a declared scope-boundary page with 200; a route the source itself does not serve answers 404. The two are visibly different answers.

evidence.observed: /m/search/tulsa-ok/braids -> 200 (851 bytes, boundary page); /m/v/nonexistent-provider-xyz -> 200 (855 bytes, boundary page); /nosuchthing -> 404 (184 bytes)

statement: All 51,833 ledgered assets exist on both sides byte-identically, and the response CSP pins connect/img/font/frame/form-action to 'self', so a remote request that survived rewriting would be blocked rather than silently made.

evidence.observed: 51,833 assets, 0 missing runtime copies, 0 byte mismatches; 465 url() references in the 10 previously extension-less stylesheets localized, 0 unresolved

statement: Signing in issues a new session token and writes it back to the cookie; the pre-login token is not reused. The rotation is the auth store's, not re-implemented in the clone.

evidence.observed: clone/app.py ajax_login sets the cookie from result['session_token']

statement: A wrong password and an unknown address both answer 401 with code invalid-credentials, so the clone does not reveal which addresses have accounts.

evidence.observed: clone/app.py _auth_error maps AuthRejected/UnknownAccount to one code

statement: The seeded fixture account uses the same scrubbed address that tools/scrub_pii.py wrote into the captured logged-in DOM, so the signed-in backend identity and the identity printed on the page are the same person.

evidence.observed: the scrubbed placeholder is the only account-shaped address in clone/frontend/pages-auth

statement: No source credential appears in the clone tree, the scope ledgers or the tools. The source login pair exists only in run/creds.env, which is outside the site directory and excluded from delivery.

evidence.observed: run/ lives beside materials/, never beneath the packaged site root

statement: No attribute that causes a browser fetch — src, srcset, imagesrcset, href, action, formaction, poster, data, ping, background, longdesc — and no CSS url() anywhere in the delivered pages or stylesheets references a remote host.
why_it_matters: The official static scan (diagnostics.REMOTE_URL) matches only src|href|action|url followed by =, ( or :. `srcset=` does not match it, so 85 Webflow CDN candidate images across 20 /join/* pages sat behind a green static gate while the browser really fetched them; only the clone's CSP stopped them, and a deployment without that CSP would have leaked. This claim is deliberately stronger than the gate it is checked by.
how_to_check: grep every listed attribute and every url() in clone/frontend/pages, clone/frontend/pages-auth and clone/static/assets for https?:// or protocol-relative //; expect zero hits. Cross-check with verify --section live: coverage.blocked_external_references must be 0.
